source.notes: THIS IS A TEST FIXTURE, NOT A RULE PACK FOR A REAL JURISDICTION. Every number in it is invented for the test suite that reads it. The country code QR is a user-assigned code that no country uses, so this file can never enable a real jurisdiction. It lives outside rule_packs/ so that the product never loads it. A real pack is written and verified by a named human against a cited source; this one is neither.
